$comment: Phase 6 component catalog (v2.0). Repo SSOT for the component list, family mapping, and the S5 common-10 suite. Replacement of any slug requires a dated change note in changeLog. A/B named gaps (space, container, masonry, navbar, steps, command-palette) are on disk and registered. Freeze-meeting sign-off remains owner=待指定.
source: Chameleon UI — 详细设计与验收说明书 v1.0 §3.3
changePolicy: Replacement requires a change note. Do not silently swap slugs.

changeLog.reason: Stack chrome (UINavigationBar / Android Toolbar). Root tabs stay on Navigation (UITabBarController). Navbar remains site/marketing links.
Three-end Navigation: one items API morphs TabBar ↔ collapsible rail ↔ persistent sidebar via container queries. Sidebar + TabBar remain specialized single-form chrome, not a morph pair.
Phase 5 (M5) named component: mobile action panel; Dialog compact morph target. schemaVersion 1.0 -> 1.1 (additive append; no existing slug touched).
Phase 5 (M5) named component: mobile bottom navigation; Navigation morph pair with sidebar.
Phase 5 (M5) named component: env(safe-area-inset-*) wrapper with 0px fallback.
Phase 5 (M5) named component: desktop persistent / tablet collapsible navigation; Navigation morph pair with tab-bar.

changeLog.note: Phase 6 breadth additions present on disk (contract + 21 locales + tests). F/G/H plus C/D/E named gaps. A/B family additions are not on disk. Not a freeze-meeting signature.
Backfilled family (A-E, plus P5 safe-area/tab-bar/sidebar/action-sheet) on the frozen 50+P5 four per Phase 6 naming rules; mapping is a proposal pending freeze-meeting sign-off.
Phase 6 A/B named gaps now on disk (contract v0.2 + 21 locales + tests) and registered. Additive append n=96-101; no existing slug touched. Not a freeze-meeting signature.

components.name: Button
components.requirement: variants/sizes/states; complete contract

components.name: Icon
components.requirement: RTL mirror matrix (mirror | preserve | localized)

components.name: Typography
components.requirement: Type scale follows breakpoints

components.name: Input
components.requirement: Validation, disabled, RTL

components.name: Textarea
components.requirement: Same states as Input

components.name: Select
components.requirement: Keyboard accessible

components.name: Checkbox
components.requirement: a11y

components.name: Radio
components.requirement: a11y

components.name: Switch
components.requirement: a11y

components.name: Form
components.requirement: Composes Input and related fields; built-in copy

components.name: Dialog
components.requirement: Desktop modal; compact → bottom sheet

components.name: Toast
components.requirement: Non-blocking feedback

components.name: Alert
components.requirement: Semantic color from tokens

components.name: Tooltip
components.requirement: Precise pointer; touch fallback

components.name: Popover
components.requirement: Desktop hover/click; compact click-to-open

components.name: Tabs
components.requirement: RTL order

components.name: Table
components.requirement: Basic table (not virtualized DataGrid)

components.name: AppShell
components.requirement: Three-breakpoint application chrome

components.name: Stack
components.requirement: Layout primitive (Stack / Space / Box)

components.name: Spinner
components.requirement: Loading feedback (Spinner / Progress)

components.name: Accordion
components.requirement: Stacks multiple collapsible sections where at most one is open at a time.

components.name: Avatar
components.requirement: Represents a user or entity with an image or initials fallback.

components.name: Badge
components.requirement: Displays a compact status indicator or count.

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.requirement: Shows the current page location within a hierarchy.

components.name: Card
components.requirement: Groups related content and actions in a contained surface.

components.name: Chip
components.requirement: Compact label or tag that may represent a filter, selection, or attribute.

components.name: Collapse
components.requirement: Toggles the visibility of a content section with a single trigger.

components.name: Combobox
components.requirement: Combines a text input with a selectable dropdown list.

components.name: DescriptionList
components.requirement: Presents a list of term-description pairs.

components.name: Divider
components.requirement: Visually separates content horizontally.

components.name: Drawer
components.requirement: Presents a sliding panel from an inline edge for secondary tasks.

components.name: EmptyState
components.requirement: Communicates an empty data set and optionally prompts the next action.

components.name: FileInput
components.requirement: Allows a user to select a file from their device.

components.name: Grid
components.requirement: Two-dimensional layout container for aligning child elements.

components.name: Heading
components.requirement: Renders a semantic heading at a chosen level.

components.name: HoverCard
components.requirement: Reveals supplementary content when the pointer hovers over a trigger.

components.name: InlineAlert
components.requirement: Displays a contextual message within a form or page.

components.name: Kbd
components.requirement: Represents a keyboard key or shortcut.

components.name: Label
components.requirement: Labels a form control with semantic association.

components.name: Link
components.requirement: Navigates to another resource or anchor.

components.name: List
components.requirement: Renders a group of related items as a list.

components.name: Menu
components.requirement: Displays a list of actions or choices in a dropdown.

components.name: NumberInput
components.requirement: Captures a numeric value with increment and decrement controls.

components.name: Pagination
components.requirement: Navigates across a set of pages.

components.name: Progress
components.requirement: Displays the completion progress of a task.

components.name: RadioCard
components.requirement: Presents radio options as selectable cards.

components.name: Separator
components.requirement: Visually and semantically separates content.

components.name: Sheet
components.requirement: Presents a modal panel anchored to an edge of the viewport.

components.name: Skeleton
components.requirement: Placeholder preview for content that is loading.

components.name: Slider
components.requirement: Selects a numeric value from a continuous range.

components.name: ActionSheet
components.requirement: Mobile action panel; Dialog compact morph target. Focus trap, Escape, drag-to-dismiss.

components.name: TabBar
components.requirement: Mobile bottom navigation; RTL order; safe-area bottom inset.

components.name: SafeArea
components.requirement: env(safe-area-inset-*) wrapper with 0px fallback for notch/gesture-bar edges.

components.name: Sidebar
components.requirement: Specialized persistent or collapsible side panel. Three-end chrome uses Navigation, not a pair with tab-bar.

components.name: ArticleCard
components.requirement: Presents an article teaser with cover, title, excerpt, metadata, and read action.

components.name: Calendar
components.requirement: Shows a navigable month grid with selectable days; weekday and month names come from Intl.

components.name: Canvas
components.requirement: Zoomable and pannable canvas base with minimap and grid snapping; Canvas 2D grid backend with a DOM node layer.

components.name: CanvasToolbar
components.requirement: Toolbar with zoom in, zoom out, reset, and fit actions for a canvas.

components.name: Carousel
components.requirement: Cycles through a sequence of slides with previous and next controls.

components.name: Chart
components.requirement: Unified chart wrapper rendering bar, line, and area series as SVG with theme colors consumed only from tokens.

components.name: ChatBubble
components.requirement: Presents a single chat message aligned and styled by its author role.

components.name: CodeBlock
components.requirement: Presents formatted source code with language label and a copy action.

components.name: ColorPicker
components.requirement: Picks a color from a swatch grid or by entering a hex value.

components.name: CommentThread
components.requirement: Displays a nested thread of comments with author, timestamp, and reply affordance.

components.name: ConfirmDialog
components.requirement: Interrupts the user with a modal confirmation before a consequential action.

components.name: DataGrid
components.requirement: Virtualized data grid rendering tens of thousands of rows in a windowed viewport with a replaceable virtualization engine.

components.name: DatePicker
components.requirement: Picks a calendar date through an input with a month-grid popover; formatting uses Intl.

components.name: Edge
components.requirement: Draws a connection line between two canvas points with an optional label.

components.name: Editor
components.requirement: Rich text editor with a minimal self-contained contentEditable kernel and a formatting toolbar.

components.name: FlowNode
components.requirement: A positioned node card for flow diagrams with input and output ports.

components.name: Gauge
components.requirement: Shows a single value on a semicircular dial against a maximum.

components.name: GraphView
components.requirement: Renders nodes and links as a deterministic ring-layout relationship diagram.

components.name: Heatmap
components.requirement: Renders a matrix of values as color-intensity cells over a token-derived scale.

components.name: Image
components.requirement: Renders an image with loading state, error fallback, and optional caption.

components.name: KpiDashboard
components.requirement: Arranges a set of key performance indicators in a responsive metric grid.

components.name: LoadingBar
components.requirement: Shows page-level loading progress as a thin bar pinned to the viewport start edge.

components.name: MarkdownRenderer
components.requirement: Renders Markdown text to semantic elements without raw HTML injection; friendly to streamed input.

components.name: MindMap
components.requirement: Lays out a topic tree as a deterministic left-to-right mind map on the canvas base.

components.name: MultiSelect
components.requirement: Selects multiple options from a listbox and shows the selection as removable chips.

components.name: Notification
components.requirement: Presents a persistent notification card with title, message, and dismiss control.

components.name: OtpInput
components.requirement: Segmented one-time-code entry with automatic focus advance and paste support.

components.name: PasswordInput
components.requirement: Password field with a visibility toggle and the same states as Input.

components.name: PipelineView
components.requirement: Shows CI/CD stages as an ordered flow with per-stage status.

components.name: Rating
components.requirement: Captures or displays a star rating from one to a configurable maximum.

components.name: Result
components.requirement: Presents the outcome of a process with status icon, title, description, and actions.

components.name: SearchBar
components.requirement: Search input with submit and clear controls inside a search landmark.

components.name: SharePanel
components.requirement: Offers share targets and a copyable link for the current content.

components.name: Sparkline
components.requirement: Renders a miniature trend line for inline placement beside metrics.

components.name: Statistic
components.requirement: Displays a single prominent metric with label, value, and optional trend indicator.

components.name: Tag
components.requirement: Presents a compact, optionally removable label for categorizing content.

components.name: Ticker
components.requirement: Shows a horizontally scrolling strip of compact market or status items.

components.name: TimePicker
components.requirement: Picks a wall-clock time via hour and minute controls formatted with Intl.

components.name: Timeline
components.requirement: Presents a chronologically ordered list of events with markers and timestamps.

components.name: Tree
components.requirement: Displays hierarchical data as an expandable and collapsible tree.

components.name: Upload
components.requirement: Complete upload control with drag and drop, paste, multi-file list, and per-file progress.

components.name: CommandPalette
components.requirement: Offers a searchable command list (⌘K pattern) with a reproducible default sort.

components.name: Container
components.requirement: Centers page content with a max inline-size and token padding that morphs by container query.

components.name: Masonry
components.requirement: Arranges uneven-height children into responsive CSS columns without a fixed row grid.

components.name: Navbar
components.requirement: Provides horizontal (or stacked, when narrow) primary navigation with an optional brand region.

components.name: Space
components.requirement: Inserts a token-sized empty gap on one or both axes without laying out children.

components.name: Steps
components.requirement: Shows sequential progress through a named series of steps, optionally allowing jump selection.

components.name: Navigation
components.requirement: Single three-end tab controller: one items API morphs from compact TabBar to collapsible rail to persistent sidebar via container queries.

components.name: NavigationBar
components.requirement: Stack chrome for the current view controller (title, back, bar items). Root destinations stay on Navigation.

s5Suite.note: S5 measures AppShell plus these 10. AppShell is not one of the 10. Phase 1 samples; Phase 2 is a release gate.
